title: PB Invoice digest
describe: Read the PDF invoices in the Nextcloud folder /Invoices-Q3 into a table with supplier, invoice number, invoice date, total amount and currency. Build an app with a dashboard (count of invoices, sum of totals, a table of all invoices). Then, as a second step on the same app, add a screen 'Per month' with a chart of the totals per month.
